command:

command:
set -eu
entry=$(getent passwd inventorysvc)
printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED] "$entry"
IFS=: read -r name passwd uid gid gecos home shell <<EOF
$entry
EOF
[ "$name" = inventorysvc ]
[ "$home" = /var/lib/inventory ]
[ "$shell" = /sbin/nologin ]
[ "$uid" -lt 1000 ]
[ -d "$home" ]
[ "$(stat -c %u "$home")" = "$uid" ]
[ "$(stat -c %g "$home")" = "$gid" ]
printf 'classification=system uid=%s gid=%s\n' "$uid" "$gid"
printf 'home_state='; stat -c 'type=%F owner=%U group=%G uid=%u gid=%g mode=%a path=%n' "$home"
shadow_field=$(getent shadow inventorysvc | cut -d: -f2)
case "$shadow_field" in !*|\**) printf 'password_state=[REDACTED] ;; *) printf 'password_state=[REDACTED]; exit 1 ;; esac
set +e
login_output=$(su - inventorysvc -c 'id' 2>&1)
login_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'interactive_login_rc=%s\n' "$login_rc"
printf 'interactive_login_output=%s\n' "$login_output"
[ "$login_rc" -ne 0 ]
printf 'verification=PASS\n'
